title: Monolith vs Microservices
sources: AWS, 'What's the Difference Between Monolithic and Microservices Architecture?' (aws.amazon.com/compare/the-difference-between-monolithic-and-microservices-architecture): a monolith is a single unit/codebase deployed together, easier to start; an error can affect the whole application; microservices are small independent services that communicate over well-defined APIs, are deployed and scaled independently, so a failure in one service is isolated; microservices add operational complexity

Atlassian, 'Microservices vs. monolithic architecture' (atlassian.com/microservices/microservices-architecture/microservices-vs-monolith): monolith = single unified unit, simpler development and deployment at first; microservices = independently deployable services with their own logic, each scaled independently; tradeoffs include added infrastructure and organizational complexity

Martin Fowler, 'MonolithFirst' (martinfowler.com/bliki/MonolithFirst.html): almost all successful microservice stories started with a monolith that got too big and was broken up; you shouldn't start a new project with microservices

lines.text: Should your app be one big program, or lots of small ones?
lines.caps: SHOULD YOUR *APP | BE ONE *BIG | *PROGRAM | OR LOTS OF | *SMALL ONES?

lines.text: Picture one kitchen that cooks everything,
pizza, sushi, dessert, all in one room.
That's a monolith: one app, shipped in one piece.
lines.caps: THAT'S A *MONOLITH | ONE *APP | SHIPPED IN | ONE *PIECE

lines.text: Simple to start, but if the fryer breaks,
where each stall cooks one thing with its own team.
lines.caps: WHERE *EACH | *STALL | COOKS *ONE THING | WITH ITS *OWN TEAM

lines.text: That's microservices: small apps that talk over APIs.
If sushi closes, pizza keeps selling,
and a busy stall adds cooks on its own.
lines.caps: AND A *BUSY | STALL ADDS *COOKS | ON ITS *OWN

lines.text: But now you're running ten kitchens, not one.
So many teams start with a monolith and split it later.
lines.caps: SO *MANY TEAMS | START WITH A | *MONOLITH | AND *SPLIT IT | *LATER

lines.text: One kitchen to start, a food court to grow.
